cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

mechanism: A calls fast assent evidence that a pupil learned confidence, postponing measurement until after accepting delivery.
confusable: The behavior is accelerated approval, not simply being optimistic that the sofa will fit.
comparison: Expiring booking versus imminent delivery workers discovering a size problem.
seedUse: D28 sofa/door/outside sequence remains, with S05 teaching confidence as the reason not to pause for consequences.
